-c import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
os.makedirs('instance', exist_ok=True)
from app import create_app, db
from app.models.user import User, UserRole
from app.models.whitelist import Whitelist
app = create_app()
ctx = app.app_context()
ctx.push()
db.create_all()
def ensure(xuid, username, password, role):
    u = User.query.filter_by(xuid=xuid).first()
    if not u:
        u = User(); u.xuid = xuid; u.username = username; u.role = role; u.set_password(password)
        db.session.add(u); db.session.flush()
    if not Whitelist.query.filter_by(xuid=xuid).first():
        w = Whitelist(); w.xuid = xuid; w.username = username; w.whitelisted_by = None
        db.session.add(w)
    db.session.commit()
    return u
admin = ensure('TESTXUID001', 'AdminTester', 'AdminPass123!', UserRole.ADMIN)
staff = ensure('TESTXUID002', 'StaffTester', 'StaffPass123!', UserRole.STAFF)
print('seeded admin id=', admin.id, 'staff id=', staff.id)

-c import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from app import create_app, db
from app.models import User, Item, Category, Auction
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
app = create_app()
with app.app_context():
    db.create_all()
    cat = Category.query.filter_by(name='Harvest Category').first()
    if not cat:
        cat = Category(name='Harvest Category'); db.session.add(cat); db.session.flush()
    item = Item.query.filter_by(name='Harvest Proof Item').first()
    if not item:
        item = Item(name='Harvest Proof Item', description='test', category_id=cat.id); db.session.add(item); db.session.flush()
    def ensure_user(username, email, password, is_admin=False, is_customer_rep=False):
        u = User.query.filter_by(username=username).first()
        if not u:
            u = User(username=username, email=email, is_admin=is_admin, is_customer_rep=is_customer_rep)
            u.set_password(password)
            db.session.add(u); db.session.flush()
        return u
    seller = ensure_user('harvestseller', 'harvestseller@example.com', 'SellerPass123!')
    bidder1 = ensure_user('harvestbidder1', 'harvestbidder1@example.com', 'BidderPass123!')
    bidder2 = ensure_user('harvestbidder2', 'harvestbidder2@example.com', 'BidderPass123!')
    rep = ensure_user('harvestrep', 'harvestrep@example.com', 'RepPass123!', is_customer_rep=True)
    auction = Auction.query.filter_by(title='Harvest Proof Auction').first()
    if not auction:
        auction = Auction(item_id=item.id, seller_id=seller.id, title='Harvest Proof Auction', description='test',
                           initial_price=10.0, min_increment=1.0, secret_min_price=5.0,
                           end_time=datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(hours=1))
        db.session.add(auction)
    db.session.commit()
    print('seeded auction id=', auction.id, 'seller=', seller.id, 'bidder1=', bidder1.id, 'bidder2=', bidder2.id, 'rep=', rep.id)

Uses the same django_manage runner kind as django-folium but needs neither PostgreSQL nor a heavy dependency set -- plain SQLite, its own small dedicated venv (Django 5.1, DRF, simplejwt).
